description: Fires at Post-Provision to attach each provisioned Azure VM to the Network Security Group selected on the order form (the azure_nsg parameter). No-ops for servers with no azure_nsg value. Ships disabled; enable once the azure_nsg parameter is wired to the Azure NSG - Generate Options plug-in (OHK-vswf8b1m) and the Azure handler is reachable.
name: Azure NSG - Attach VM to NSG
